Story dialogue voices (ElevenLabs, model eleven_v4). Each speaker's lines are generated as one take joined by "

[long pause]

" (tools/audio/voice_plan.json lists the batches: chunk, voice, and [conversation, line index, text, speaker]), then cut with tools/audio/split_voice.py into assets/audio/vo/<conversation>_<line>.ogg. Lines with no letters ("...") keep the blips. ElevenLabs refuses prompts containing the word for a sewing pin's bigger cousin, so the dialogue avoids it.
